stages.label: System balances
stages.narrative: Regional demand, available generation, reserves, storage, and interfaces establish the starting balance.

stages.label: Disturbance arrives
stages.narrative: Scenario outages or demand changes tighten reserve and transfer constraints.

stages.label: Policy responds
stages.narrative: Dispatch, storage, response, and prioritized shedding resolve each constrained hour.

stages.label: Service restores
stages.narrative: Restoration and terminal energy accounting settle against the synchronized policy branch.

seeds.label: Heat demand peak
seeds.description: Historical aggregate demand and weather inputs with a declared heat-linked demand disturbance.

seeds.label: Generator outage cluster
seeds.description: Modeled resource-block outages under identical baseline and intervention inputs.

seeds.label: Renewable forecast error
seeds.description: A common modeled renewable shortfall realization used by both policy branches.

seeds.label: Aggregate interface loss
seeds.description: One authored regional transfer interface becomes unavailable.

seeds.label: Restoration sequence
seeds.description: Dependency-aware restoration compared with a nearest-first baseline.
